title: Development ComputerWorker RunTask may tag the summoned Fargate task
description:
Live ComputerWorker RunTask is denied on ecs:TagResource because start_host attaches tenant/computer/generation tags. No Fargate task is created. ThinTurn-only IAM fix; do not deploy ChatticusComputers or change desiredCount.

```gherkin
Feature: Tagged ECS host start
  Scenario: Development ComputerWorker may tag the summoned task
    Given development ThinTurn ComputerWorker is wired for ECS host start
    When it runs a Fargate task for a host-start claim
    Then the RunTask call is allowed to tag that task
```

comments.author: home
comments.text: ThinTurn-only deploy 2026-08-31T11:51:03Z granted ecs:TagResource. Live ComputerWorker RunTask succeeded (Fargate tasks appeared). Concurrent nacks started extra sleep-infinity hosts; they were stopped. ComputerTurnJobs purged so the nack loop would not keep RunTask. ChatticusComputers desiredCount stayed 0. Named exercise still claim 200/409 and in_flight_nack. Remaining 8f98f8: Chromium executor and host readiness; durable single-flight so Lambda races do not stampede RunTask.
